source_database: data/pennant.db (repository snapshot; user-mentioned 07_pennant.db was not present)

target.filter: season_label = '2026途中' AND top_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL

measurement_source.value: NPB+ tracking data is publicly described as based on Hawk-Eye Innovations tracking.

display_label.value: The public NPB+ materials use the Sprint Speed / スプリント label.

measurement_spec.collection_limit: No app scraping or bulk extraction was used; the public specification was checked only from official pages and linked public materials.

proxy_definition.full_effort_run_proxy_count: sum of existing infield grounder batter records, baserunning advance records, and non-pickoff second-base steal-related records; not unique plays and not a speed measurement

official_2026_exposure.source_scope: NPB official individual batting pages for all 12 teams

official_2025_exposure.source_scope: all 12 NPB team pages, aggregated across teams for transfers

full_effort_run_proxy.warning: record-count proxy, not a speed measurement or unique full-effort run count

not disclosed in public NPB+ materials; no app bulk extraction or scraping performed
existing derived PBP tables were sufficient for a bounded proxy; no new large data infrastructure was added
acquisition_log.coverage_limit: PBP proxy ends 2026-07-18 while official exposure is 2026-08-08

conflicts_resolved.resolution: searched all 12 team pages and summed matching team rows

source_problems: PBP-derived tables have an earlier cutoff than the official 2026 batting pages
unresolved: 名原 典彦 has no matching 2025 official batting row
all NPB+ Tier A sample and aggregation fields are unavailable
starts, pinch-run, and pinch-hit-only appearances are unavailable
negative_findings: this dataset cannot establish whether low exposure causes NPB+ Sprint Speed to fall below PowerPro
this dataset cannot determine whether a player's observed Sprint Speed represents an ability ceiling
proxy counts cannot be used as NPB+ sample counts or as appraisal corrections
postprocess_warnings: pa_bucket is a mechanical aggregation flag, not an invalidation rule
do not convert HP-to-1B time into Sprint Speed
do not mix steal or PBP proxy counts into the speed appraisal
